about: Bye Sweet Carole Bye Sweet Carole is a chilling narrative-horror game inspired by classic animation movies and created by Chris Darril (Remothered series).
Follow the last known whereabouts of Carole Simmons to uncover the dark truth behind the Bunny Hall orphanage.
Until Then A fateful meeting sets off a chain reaction, upending Mark's life. People disappear and memories prove unreliable.
Uncover a hidden truth with Mark and his friends in this narrative adventure and race to unravel the mystery before it's too late.
